questions.stem: Which of the following is a benefit of cloud computing that allows a company to pay only for the compute resources it consumes?

options.reason: High availability is a reliability characteristic, not a billing model.
AWS bills for compute, storage, and data transfer based on actual usage with no long-term commitment required.
Elasticity describes the ability to scale resources up and down, not how you are charged for them.
Global reach refers to AWS's worldwide infrastructure, not its billing model.

questions.stem: Which AWS Cloud design principle helps an architecture withstand failures of individual components?

options.reason: Tight coupling increases the blast radius of failures; AWS recommends loose coupling.
Monolithic systems concentrate risk; one failure can affect everything.
Assuming components will fail and building redundancy and graceful degradation in is a core AWS design principle.
Vertical scaling alone creates a single point of failure and does not address component-level failure.

questions.stem: Under the AWS Shared Responsibility Model, which task is the customer's responsibility?

options.text: Patching the hypervisor on EC2 host machines
options.reason: AWS is responsible for the infrastructure, including the hypervisor — security OF the cloud.

options.text: Maintaining physical security of data centers
options.reason: AWS manages physical security of its facilities.

options.text: Configuring security groups and IAM permissions
options.reason: The customer is responsible for security IN the cloud, which includes IAM, security groups, and OS-level configuration.

options.text: Replacing failed hard drives in data centers
options.reason: Hardware lifecycle management is AWS's responsibility.

questions.stem: Which AWS service provides centralized management of encryption keys?

options.reason: Secrets Manager stores and rotates secrets like database credentials; it uses KMS keys but does not manage them as its primary purpose.
AWS Key Management Service is the dedicated service for creating, controlling, and auditing cryptographic keys.
AWS WAF protects web applications from common exploits; it is not a key management service.
AWS Shield is a DDoS protection service.

questions.stem: Which TWO AWS services help protect against Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) attacks? (Choose TWO.)

options.reason: AWS Shield is purpose-built DDoS protection (Standard is free; Advanced is paid).
Inspector performs vulnerability assessments on EC2 and container workloads, not DDoS protection.
AWS WAF filters malicious HTTP/HTTPS traffic and works alongside Shield to mitigate application-layer DDoS.
AWS Config tracks resource configuration history and compliance; it does not block traffic.
Trusted Advisor provides recommendations on cost, performance, and security but does not actively defend against DDoS.

questions.stem: Which AWS service is a fully managed NoSQL database?

options.reason: RDS is a managed relational database service (MySQL, PostgreSQL, etc.).
Redshift is a relational data warehouse.
DynamoDB is AWS's fully managed key-value and document NoSQL database with single-digit millisecond performance.
Aurora is a MySQL- and PostgreSQL-compatible relational database.

questions.stem: A company wants to run containers without managing the underlying EC2 instances. Which service should they choose?

options.text: Amazon ECS on EC2 launch type
options.reason: EC2 launch type still requires the customer to manage the EC2 container hosts.
Fargate is a serverless compute engine for containers — AWS manages the underlying infrastructure.
EC2 Auto Scaling manages groups of EC2 instances, not containers directly.
AWS Batch runs batch jobs and can use Fargate or EC2, but it is not itself a serverless container runtime.

questions.stem: Which TWO services can be used to distribute content to end users with low latency? (Choose TWO.)

options.reason: CloudFront is AWS's global content delivery network (CDN) with edge locations worldwide.
Global Accelerator uses the AWS global network to route user traffic to optimal application endpoints.
Glacier is for long-term archival; retrieval can take minutes to hours.
Direct Connect is a dedicated private connection between on-premises and AWS, not a user-facing CDN.
EBS provides block storage for EC2; it is not a content distribution service.

questions.stem: Which AWS support plan provides 24/7 access to a designated Technical Account Manager (TAM)?

options.reason: Basic support is free and does not include a TAM.
Developer support offers business-hours email access to Cloud Support Associates only.
Business support offers 24/7 access to Cloud Support Engineers but no designated TAM.
Enterprise (and Enterprise On-Ramp) support includes a designated Technical Account Manager.

questions.stem: Which tool provides a side-by-side cost comparison between running workloads on-premises vs. in AWS?

options.reason: Cost Explorer visualizes existing AWS spend, not on-premises comparisons.
The Pricing Calculator estimates AWS costs but does not directly compare on-premises totals.

options.text: AWS Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) tools / Migration Evaluator
options.reason: AWS Migration Evaluator (formerly TSO Logic) is the AWS tool for on-premises vs. cloud TCO comparisons.
AWS Budgets sets thresholds and alerts on AWS spend; it does not compare to on-premises costs.
